title: Treasure Hunt draws its original bombs
summary: Treasure Hunt now draws the original bomb model at each live treasure, looping its original animation, and hides a bomb when it is collected or while the next group waits. Checked on all 14 venues (one bomb per treasure).
details: Verification: private all-venue check, browser games test passes on host Chromium. PR #368.
limitation: the sparks and explosion bursts are not emitted yet; the screen tags remain.
